title: Dapagliflozin inhibits ferroptosis and ameliorates renal fibrosis in diabetic C57BL/6J mice.
authors: Zhang, Zhen; Li, Luxin; Dai, Yucen; Lian, Yifei; Song, Haixu; Dai, Xin; Su, Ranyu; Yin, Jiaxing; Gu, Ruimin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究达格列净抑制铁死亡改善糖尿病肾病纤维化，涉及分子对接但核心为疾病表型与信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diabetic nephropathy (DN) is a common complication of diabetes and a major cause of end-stage renal disease, with complex pathogenesis involving inflammation, oxidative stress, fibrosis, and ferroptosis. Ferroptosis is linked to DN progression, yet treatment options are limited, particularly for targeting ferroptosis. Dapagliflozin (DAPA), an SGLT2 inhibitor, shows renal protective effects in diabetes, but its role in renal fibrosis and ferroptosis in DN is unclear. This study investigated DAPA's effect on renal fibrosis in DN by inhibiting ferroptosis, using a streptozotocin-induced diabetic mouse model. Results indicated that DAPA improved renal function, reduced fibrosis, and suppressed ferroptosis markers in diabetic mice. In vitro, DAPA inhibited ferroptosis and fibrosis in HK-2 cells under high glucose conditions. Molecular docking and network pharmacology suggested DAPA's anti-fibrotic and anti-ferroptotic effects may involve the Nrf2 and TGF-beta signaling pathways. DAPA also reduced serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen in diabetic mice, improved glomerulosclerosis and interstitial fibrosis, decreased iron deposition, and enhanced antioxidant activity. Overall, DAPA's multi-target mechanisms significantly improve DN progression, suggesting its potential as a targeted therapy against ferroptosis. Future studies should further explore DAPA's applications.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DN）是糖尿病的常见并发症，也是终末期肾病的主要原因，其发病机制复杂，涉及炎症、氧化应激、纤维化和铁死亡。铁死亡与DN进展相关，但治疗选择有限，尤其是针对铁死亡的靶向治疗。达格列净（DAPA）作为一种SGLT2抑制剂，在糖尿病中显示出肾脏保护作用，但其在DN肾纤维化和铁死亡中的作用尚不清楚。本研究通过使用链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠模型，探讨了DAPA通过抑制铁死亡对DN肾纤维化的影响。结果表明，DAPA改善了糖尿病小鼠的肾功能，减少了纤维化，并抑制了铁死亡标志物。在体外实验中，DAPA在高糖条件下抑制了HK-2细胞的铁死亡和纤维化。分子对接和网络药理学提示，DAPA的抗纤维化和抗铁死亡作用可能涉及Nrf2和TGF-β信号通路。DAPA还降低了糖尿病小鼠的血清肌酐和血尿素氮，改善了肾小球硬化和间质纤维化，减少了铁沉积，并增强了抗氧化活性。总体而言，DAPA的多靶点机制显著改善了DN进展，表明其作为针对铁死亡的靶向治疗的潜力。未来研究应进一步探索DAPA的应用。
